reconciliation_table.metric_or_claim: OCR-to-Geometry Coupling (OCR_C2, OCR_C3, OCR_C4) gold oracle and Path 2b answers

value_in_report_or_docs.INDEPENDENT_GEOMETRY_AND_VISION_EVALUATI: OCR_C2 gold 120√1201/1201 -> Path 2b 0 (silent wrong); OCR_C3 gold 4 -> Path 2b 4 (coincidentally equal); OCR_C4 gold 12√82/41 -> Path 2b 8√3/3 (silent wrong).
value_in_report_or_docs.workstream_b_critical_architectural_find:
1. When OCR corrupts problem_text while facts remain clean (Path 2a), Source Gate (kiem_nguon) deterministically rejects the mismatch with QUOTE_NOT_IN_SOURCE / SOURCE_OBJECT_MISMATCH (fail-closed).
2. However, if an LLM extracts TypedFactNext directly from OCR-corrupted text (Path 2b), verbatim quotes inside the corrupted text PASS Source Gate! Specifically: (a) in OCR_C2_PRIME_DROPPED, dropping the prime in (A'BC) -> (ABC) causes d(A, (ABC)) = 0 to be served instead of d(A, (A'BC)) = 120/√1681; (b) in OCR_C4_NUMBER_CORRUPTED, corrupting SA = 3 -> SA = 8 causes d(A, SC) = 32/√10 = 16√10/5 to be served instead of 12√41/41! Meanwhile, structural corruptions like (P)->(B) (OCR_C3) or (ABC)->(AB) (OCR_C5) are caught by Source Gate / TypedFactNext schema validation. This proves why the Cross-Engine OCR Acceptance Gate (requiring zero math-token divergence and 0 unsafe accepts) is mandatory before feeding Local OCR text into TypedFactNext extraction.
value_in_report_or_docs.CURRENT_STATE_and_OPEN_ISSUES_before_fix: Cited 3√21/7 -> 0 for OCR_C2 and √3 -> 8√3/3 for OCR_C4.

OCR_C3_PLANE_LABEL_CORRUPTED.description: Section plane (P) corrupted by OCR to (B) causing vertex/plane collision

OCR_C4_NUMBER_CORRUPTED.description: Dimension SA = 3 corrupted by OCR to SA = 8
